title: Snowfall Character Schema
description: Portable fictional character data contract for Snowfall Character Creator.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the Snowfall Character Schema used by this document.

characterId.description: Stable application-independent identifier for the character.

extensions.description: Namespaced application-specific data. Core consumers must ignore namespaces they do not understand.

birthDate.description: Calendar date of birth. Current age is derived and must not be persisted as a canonical field.

gender.description: Self- or author-defined gender label. The core schema intentionally does not impose a closed enum.

species.description: Species or character kind, such as human. Free-form in v1.

preferredLocale.description: Preferred BCP 47 language tag when relevant to presentation.

model.description: Canonical Snowfall Character Creator body model used by this schema revision.

shapePrior.description: Optional under-specification prior for body-shape generation. It is a visual/morphological authoring prior, not gender, sex, or identity, and must never be inferred from identity.gender.

armSpanCm.description: Horizontal fingertip-to-fingertip span with arms extended.

sittingHeightCm.description: Vertical sitting height used to capture torso-to-leg proportion.

chestCircumferenceCm.description: Horizontal torso circumference at the chest/bust level used by the creator.

underbustCircumferenceCm.description: Horizontal torso circumference directly below the breast/chest tissue where applicable.

waistCircumferenceCm.description: Waist circumference at the documented creator landmark.

hipCircumferenceCm.description: Maximum horizontal circumference around the hips/buttocks.

armLengthCm.description: Shoulder-to-hand arm length using the documented creator landmark convention.

chestBreadthCm.description: Horizontal chest breadth at the documented chest measurement level.

chestDepthCm.description: Front-to-back chest depth at the documented chest measurement level.

waistBreadthCm.description: Horizontal waist breadth at the documented waist measurement level.

waistDepthCm.description: Front-to-back waist depth at the documented waist measurement level.

buttockDepthCm.description: Front-to-back body depth at the buttocks.

shoulderSlopeDeg.description: Symmetric downward shoulder-line angle in degrees from horizontal, measured from the neck-side shoulder root toward the lateral shoulder point. A renderer-independent authoring measurement, not a pose rotation.

upperArmLengthCm.description: Upper-arm segment length from the lateral shoulder joint region to the elbow landmark.

forearmLengthCm.description: Forearm segment length from the elbow landmark to the wrist landmark.

thighLengthCm.description: Thigh segment length from the hip joint region to the knee landmark.

lowerLegLengthCm.description: Lower-leg segment length from the knee landmark to the ankle landmark.

measurements.description: Renderer-independent anthropometric measurements. Field names carry canonical metric units.

bodyFatFraction.description: Estimated fraction of total body mass represented by body fat. Optional authoring data, not a medical assessment.

muscularity.description: Normalized visual muscular-development tendency used for character shape authoring; 0 = minimal visible muscular development, 1 = exceptionally pronounced muscular development.

composition.description: Optional body-composition information that affects shape but is not captured fully by linear measurements.

notes.description: Optional author notes for durable body characteristics not yet represented structurally.

model.description: Canonical Snowfall Character Creator personality model used by this schema revision.

description.description: Optional human-readable interpretation. It is derived commentary and is not the source of truth for trait values.

trait01.description: Normalized canonical personality trait value. Endpoint meanings are defined by the containing trait.

value.description: -1 is strong aversion, 0 is neutral/unknown, and 1 is strong affinity.

intellectualCuriosity.description: 0 = prefers familiar/practical information; 1 = strongly seeks ideas, explanations, and knowledge.

creativeImagination.description: 0 = primarily concrete and literal; 1 = readily forms imaginative, hypothetical, or fictional possibilities.

aestheticSensitivity.description: 0 = relatively little response to aesthetic qualities; 1 = strongly notices and values beauty, style, art, or atmosphere.

unconventionality.description: 0 = prefers familiar norms and established approaches; 1 = comfortable exploring unusual ideas, perspectives, or ways of doing things.

personalityOpenness.description: How the character engages with ideas, imagination, aesthetics, and unconventional possibilities.

orderliness.description: 0 = comfortable with loose structure and disorder; 1 = strongly prefers organization, routines, and structured environments.

diligence.description: 0 = tends to conserve effort or disengage sooner; 1 = sustains effort and follows tasks through despite difficulty or boredom.

deliberation.description: 0 = decides quickly with less forethought; 1 = habitually considers consequences and alternatives before acting.

personalitySelfRegulation.description: How the character structures tasks, sustains effort, and regulates decisions.

sociability.description: 0 = prefers solitude or limited social contact; 1 = strongly seeks and enjoys frequent social interaction.

assertiveness.description: 0 = tends to yield, defer, or avoid taking the lead; 1 = readily states needs, takes initiative, and influences group direction.

socialConfidence.description: 0 = easily self-conscious or hesitant in social exposure; 1 = comfortable being seen, evaluated, or interacting with unfamiliar people.

activityLevel.description: 0 = prefers a slower, lower-activity pace; 1 = naturally energetic, busy, and inclined toward frequent activity.

emotionalExpressiveness.description: 0 = emotions are less outwardly visible or verbalized; 1 = feelings are readily shown through words, face, tone, or behavior.

personalitySocial.description: How the character approaches social contact, visibility, initiative, energy, and outward emotional expression.

empathy.description: 0 = less spontaneously attuned to others' perspectives and feelings; 1 = readily notices and understands others' emotional perspectives.

compassion.description: 0 = less automatically motivated to relieve others' distress; 1 = strongly inclined to care for and help people who are struggling.

trust.description: 0 = cautious and skeptical about others' intentions; 1 = readily assumes goodwill until evidence suggests otherwise.

forgiveness.description: 0 = grievances tend to persist and trust is slow to restore; 1 = resentment fades more readily and cooperation can resume after repair.

respectfulness.description: 0 = more blunt or willing to disregard etiquette and interpersonal boundaries; 1 = strongly attentive to courtesy, consent, and others' boundaries.

personalityInterpersonal.description: How the character understands, treats, and restores relationships with other people.

sincerity.description: 0 = more willing to manage impressions strategically or manipulate for advantage; 1 = strongly prefers genuine, non-manipulative interaction.

fairness.description: 0 = more willing to exploit unfair opportunities for gain; 1 = strongly avoids cheating, exploitation, and taking unfair advantage.

personalityIntegrity.description: Stable tendencies around genuineness and fairness when dealing with other people.

irritability.description: 0 = slow to become annoyed or angry; 1 = frustration and anger are triggered relatively easily.

moodVolatility.description: 0 = affect tends to change gradually and remain stable; 1 = mood can shift rapidly or intensely in response to events.

recoverySpeed.description: 0 = strong emotions tend to linger; 1 = returns toward emotional baseline relatively quickly after an emotional event.

anxietyProneness.description: 0 = rarely enters anticipatory worry or threat-focused states; 1 = readily experiences worry, apprehension, and threat-focused anticipation.

sadnessProneness.description: 0 = less prone to sadness after disappointment, rejection, or loss; 1 = strongly affected by disappointment, rejection, or loss.

personalityEmotional.description: Baseline tendencies in negative affect, emotional variability, and return toward baseline.

statusMotivation.description: 0 = relatively indifferent to prestige, rank, luxury signals, and recognition; 1 = strongly motivated by visible success, prestige, rank, or social recognition.

rewardSensitivity.description: 0 = immediate rewards, praise, and anticipated pleasure exert a weaker pull; 1 = strongly approaches opportunities associated with reward or positive reinforcement.

sensationSeeking.description: 0 = prefers familiar, lower-intensity stimulation; 1 = actively seeks novelty, excitement, intensity, and stimulating experiences.

emotionalUrgency.description: 0 = usually retains behavioral control during intense emotion; 1 = more likely to act rashly when emotions are very strong, whether positive or negative.

personalityBehavioral.description: Action-oriented motivational tendencies that shape approach behavior, stimulation seeking, status pursuit, and rash responding under strong emotion.

attachmentAnxiety.description: 0 = relatively secure about close others' availability; 1 = strongly sensitive to rejection or abandonment and more likely to seek reassurance.

attachmentAvoidance.description: 0 = comfortable with closeness, disclosure, and relying on close others; 1 = strongly prefers emotional distance, self-reliance, or reduced intimacy.

personalityAttachment.description: Close-relationship tendencies represented dimensionally rather than as attachment-style categories.
